lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: Multiple explosions reported across Old Market. Power is failing. The main road to the clinic is blocked.

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: Joint Response Command, this is District Dispatch. Do you copy? The district relay is down. The command channel has gone silent.

lines.speaker: DALIA
lines.text: District Dispatch, Major Dalia Rahim, JRC Field Command. We found the convoy survivors. Extraction is underway.

lines.speaker: SAMIRA
lines.text: Field Command, this is Engineer Samira Haddad with Civil Infrastructure. Families and road crews are trapped beyond the clinic route.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I'm ARIA, the Civic Relay assistant. Relay integrity is degraded. Command channels remain offline.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Emergency continuity protocol is now active. One verified command authority remains.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Old Market is the immediate priority. Armed units are closing in on the blocked clinic route.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Commander identity confirmed. I will provide tactical support. You retain command authority.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: The failures were deliberate: power, roads, then command.

lines.speaker: DALIA
lines.text: Two JRC squads still active. The nearest forward post has gone dark.

lines.speaker: SAMIRA
lines.text: Civilians, clinic staff, and municipal crews are still trapped beyond the roadblock.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: We do not yet have enough evidence to identify who is behind the attack.

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: Link the response teams. Secure the clinic corridor. Confirm targets before engaging.

lines.speaker: DALIA
lines.text: Confirmed. Armed Ash Line patrol approaching Old Market. No heavy weapons observed.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Three armed hostiles confirmed. Civilians are still behind the barriers. Engage only within the marked corridor.

lines.speaker: DALIA
lines.text: Field units standing by. You have tactical control, Commander.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Select the rifle squad. Move them into cover. Secure the corridor.
